items.title: The Fed says inflation hasn’t gotten any better ahead of its key December vote to raise rates
items.summary: The Fed says inflation hasn’t gotten any better ahead of its key December vote to raise rates. Stubborn inflation remains a concern for an expanding economy. (MarketWatch)

items.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
items.summary: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation. He expressed confidence inflation will approach the 2% target in 2027. (CNBC)

items.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
items.summary: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show. Minutes from the October meeting where rates were held steady were released. (CNBC)

items.title: New-home sales just hit a 2026 high as builders dangle low mortgages and Black Friday deals
items.summary: New-home sales just hit a 2026 high as builders dangle low mortgages and Black Friday deals. Sales surged to the highest level this year in October. (MarketWatch)

items.title: Oracle, CoreWeave and other tech stocks bounce back after selloff
items.summary: Oracle, CoreWeave and other tech stocks bounce back after selloff. Technology stocks recovered from early losses on Wednesday as the selloff eased. (MarketWatch)

items.title: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites
items.summary: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites. This constellation would increase the number of satellites in orbit by roughly 50-fold. (Ars Technica)

items.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
items.summary: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space. The authorization covers AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the "Starmind" initiative. (The Verge)

items.title: How data centers are driving a US natural-gas boom
items.summary: How data centers are driving a US natural-gas boom. AI demand is accelerating the trend of data centers using dedicated natural gas power plants. (MIT Technology Review)

items.title: Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival
items.summary: Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival. The service combines privacy promises with AI features. (Ars Technica)

items.title: Guilty: Huawei faces steep penalties for stealing T-Mobile, Cisco trade secrets
items.summary: Guilty: Huawei faces steep penalties for stealing T-Mobile, Cisco trade secrets. Huawei didn’t try very hard to hide thefts of US trade secrets, DOJ says. (Ars Technica)

items.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
items.summary: Thirty-one people were killed and 21 injured after a fuel tanker crashed and overturned on a busy ring road in Cairo, causing a massive fire. (BBC News)

items.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
items.summary: The US has announced new tariffs on a host of countries including China and the EU, hitting many of America's biggest trading partners. (BBC News)

items.title: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
items.summary: Ukraine says five Russian military jets were hit in a strike on the Savasleyka airfield, which hosts aircraft used to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs. (BBC News)

items.title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
items.summary: An Israeli strike in Gaza City killed senior Hamas security official Mohammed Abu al-Ouf along with his wife and two teenage daughters. (BBC News)

items.title: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
items.summary: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in the Ukraine war, with leaked data revealing major changes in mortality patterns. (BBC News)
